ShowOrMinimize.Name: Show / minimize DM Screen
ShowOrMinimize.Hint: Opens the DM Screen. When it is open, minimizes it. When it is minimized, restores it. Gamemaster only.

Toggle.Name: Open / close DM Screen
Toggle.Hint: Opens or closes the DM Screen. Gamemaster only.

AllowAssistant.Name: Allow Assistant GMs
AllowAssistant.Hint: When enabled, Assistant GMs can also open the DM Screen. By default only the Gamemaster can.

Toolbar.HiddenBoxes: {count} box(es) outside the grid are kept. Enlarge the grid to see them.
Toolbar.ReadOnly: Saved by a newer version of this module. Changes are not saved.

Box.Title: Box title
Box.RemoveConfirmContent: Remove this box and its contents? This cannot be undone.
Box.Unsupported: This box type needs a newer version of Roll101 DM Screen.
Box.ReconnectHint: Drag a replacement here to reconnect, or remove the box.
Box.DropHint: or drop a journal, table, table folder or table compendium
Box.Move: Drag to move. Dropping on another box swaps them.

Notifications.SaveFailed: DM Screen: changes could not be saved. See the console (F12) for details.
Notifications.DropFolderType: Only rollable table folders can be added.
Notifications.DropPackType: Only compendiums of rollable tables can be added.
Notifications.DropUnsupported: This item cannot be added to the DM Screen.
Notifications.DropOccupied: This cell is in use. Drop on an empty cell, or on a box of the same type to replace its link.
Notifications.NotFound: This document was deleted or cannot be found.

Missing.Journal: This journal was deleted or cannot be found.
Missing.Table: This rollable table was deleted or cannot be found.
Missing.Folder: This table folder or compendium was deleted or cannot be found.

Journal.OpenToView: This page type cannot be shown here. Use Open.

Table.More: +{count} more results. Use Open to see all.

Folder.Empty: No rollable tables in this folder.
Folder.RollAll: Roll every table in this folder at once

Result.Title: Result
Result.Empty: No result. The table may have no results left to draw.
Result.Missing: This table was deleted or cannot be found.
Result.Failed: The roll failed. See the console (F12) for details.
